meta.title: Handoff Kit
meta.description: Generates, verifies and lists deterministic session handoff packages (HANDOFF.md + manifest.json) with git and file-hash evidence.

ui.app.title: Handoff
ui.app.subtitle: Create and load session handoff packages
ui.app.composerTitle: Handoff: create or load handoff packages
ui.toast.copyManual: Could not copy automatically; select the text manually
ui.toast.directoryCopyManual: Could not copy automatically; select the directory manually
ui.toast.insertUnavailable: Cannot insert: open the panel from the Handoff button in the composer
ui.error.unreachable: Cannot reach the Host service (the page or the Host may be restarting).
ui.error.unreachableRemedy: Refresh the page and retry; if it still fails, confirm the plugin is enabled and the page is served by this local DSH instance.
ui.error.badResponse: The Host returned a response that could not be parsed.
ui.error.badResponseRemedy: Retry; if it still fails, check the DSH logs.
ui.remedy.HANDOFF_READ_ONLY: This session is read-only: switch the target to workspace or use a workspace-write session.
ui.remedy.HANDOFF_SANDBOX_DENIED: The Host sandbox refused this write: check the session permission or switch the target to workspace.
ui.remedy.HANDOFF_PATH_ESCAPE: Path escaped the allowed root: check the target and the workspace directory.
ui.remedy.HANDOFF_BATCH_EXISTS: That batch already exists: enable overwrite (force) or retry later.
ui.remedy.HANDOFF_BATCH_NOT_FOUND: No usable handoff batch found: refresh the list or create one on the Create tab first.
ui.remedy.HANDOFF_RESUME_NOT_FOUND: No usable handoff batch found: refresh the list or create one on the Create tab first.
ui.remedy.HANDOFF_VERIFY_INVALID: This batch is incomplete or failed verification: do not trust it; inspect the findings or regenerate it.
ui.remedy.HANDOFF_APPEND_TARGET_MISSING: There is no batch to continue yet: create one on the Create tab, then continue the handoff.
ui.remedy.HANDOFF_LINEAGE_CYCLE: Invalid lineage target (a batch cannot follow itself): leave it empty to use the latest batch.
ui.remedy.HANDOFF_MIGRATION_SOURCE_INVALID: The source batch failed verification: fix or regenerate it before migrating.
ui.remedy.HANDOFF_MIGRATION_UNSUPPORTED_VER: This schema version cannot be migrated by this build: upgrade the plugin.
ui.remedy.HANDOFF_MANIFEST_MISSING: This batch is incomplete or failed verification: do not trust it; inspect the findings or regenerate it.
ui.remedy.HANDOFF_MANIFEST_INVALID: This batch is incomplete or failed verification: do not trust it; inspect the findings or regenerate it.
ui.remedy.HANDOFF_WRITE_FAILED: The Host failed to read or write: check directory permissions and disk space, then retry.
ui.remedy.HANDOFF_READ_FAILED: The Host failed to read or write: check directory permissions and disk space, then retry.
ui.remedy.HANDOFF_SECRET_CHECK_FAILED: Possible secret content was detected: clean it up and create the package again.
ui.remedy.HANDOFF_INVALID_ARGS: Invalid arguments: check the form and retry.
ui.remedy.HANDOFF_INTERNAL: Host internal error: retry once; if it still fails, check the DSH logs.
ui.create.titlePlaceholder: Handoff batch title (used in the manifest / list)
ui.create.summaryHint: Optional, written into the H1 narrative of HANDOFF.md
ui.create.summaryPlaceholder: One line about what matters in this handoff and what is unfinished
ui.create.dirNote: Actual batch directory = root / project key / batchId; the Host computes it and shows it after creation. Nothing is written before you click.
ui.create.includeDiffs: Include session change diffs (≤20 files / ≤512 KiB)
ui.create.busyNote: Collecting evidence and writing the package; this can take a few seconds… (this click confirmed the write)
ui.field.title: Title
ui.prompt.heading: New-session opening prompt
ui.detail.loading: Verifying: reading the package and re-checking hashes and drift…
ui.detail.empty: Pick a batch on the left to inspect trust / drift / findings and copy the opening prompt.
ui.detail.driftChanged: Drift: gitHead {head} · {changed} source files changed · {missing} missing
ui.detail.driftClean: Drift: none (gitHead unchanged, source hashes match)
ui.load.empty: No batches yet. Switch to Create to make your first handoff package.
ui.continue.title: Continue handoff
ui.continue.subtitle: Writes a new batch; older batches are never modified
ui.continue.updateNote: Creates a new generation and records supersedes for the latest batch; the old batch stays untouched and read-only. Requires a second confirmation.
ui.continue.appendNote: Appends a generation after the latest batch (lineage.previous); the old batch stays untouched.
ui.continue.dirNote: The Host derives the actual batch directory from the project key and shows it after the write. Nothing is written before you click.
ui.continue.confirmNote: Second confirmation: a new supersedes batch will be created; the old batch is kept read-only.
ui.workbench.description: A handoff package is the evidence behind the new-session opening prompt; write actions (create / continue) show the target directory first and run only after you click.
ui.selector.title: Project / session
ui.selector.hint: Choose the session whose workspace this workbench reads and writes; the project follows the session. Host default resolves the newest live session.
ui.selector.knownEmpty: No session recorded yet: open a conversation, click Handoff once, then return here.
ui.selector.noticeImplicit: This workbench is not explicitly bound: the Host resolved session {id}, so reads and writes use {cwd}. Choose a session above to pin it.
ui.selector.noticeFallback: No live session is bound, so the Host falls back to {cwd}. Choose a session above (or open a conversation and click Handoff) to pin this workbench.
ui.selector.noticeStale: Session {pinned} is not live; the Host resolved {resolved} instead. Pick a live session above or use Host default.
